sentences.en: The little girl was absorbed in reading a fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 那个小女孩正全神贯注地读着一篇童话故事。

sentences.en: The author translated the fairy tale into our mother tongue.
sentences.zh: 作者将这篇童话翻译成了我们的母语。

sentences.en: These tales have been passed on from generation to generation.
sentences.zh: 这些传说从一代传到下一代。
